weekly_objective: Return safely to about 10 hours of training after an unplanned week off, with only two hard days, while watching HRV that is below baseline and a rising resting HR.
coach_says: Last week was effectively a full week off (load 16, no planned sessions done), so your form is very fresh (+46%), but HRV of 41 ms is below your 44-58 baseline and resting HR is 3 bpm up and rising. That makes this a controlled re-entry week of about 10 hours: Tuesday's committed rides and an indoor Saturday threshold session plus gym are the only hard days, and the long ride goes on dry Friday. If resting HR reaches 56+ or HRV stays under 44 alongside poor sleep, use the fallbacks, and if last week's break was illness, keep everything easy until you have had 2-3 normal mornings.

days.details:
Warmup: 300 m - 200 m easy free + 4x25 m drill (catch-up / fingertip drag), 15 s rest
Main set: 6x100 m steady aerobic free at RPE 4-5, 20 s rest
Cooldown: 100 m easy choice
Total: 1000 m
Objective: Get moving again after the week off with low-impact aerobic work that leaves you fresh for Tuesday's committed rides.

days.session: Committed double: AM controlled hills + PM hard MTB group ride
days.details:
AM (before work):
60 min | Controlled hill ride, aerobic strength | Z2 with climbs at Z3, cap RPE 6
Warm-up: 15 min Z2
Main: 4 climbs of 5-6 min at Z3 (seated, 70-80 rpm), easy Z1-2 descent/spin between
Cool-down: 10 min Z1-2
Showers and gusts to 29 km/h: lights on, descend cautiously. If roads are flooded or heavy rain hits, ride the same structure on Zwift.

PM (after work):
90 min | Hard MTB group ride | RPE 7-9 efforts as the group dictates
First hard ride after 10 days off: ride the first 20 min conservatively, then join the surges.
Fuel: 1 bottle with 30-60 g carbs, plus a snack between rides.
days.fallback: If HRV is below 44 ms and resting HR is 56+ bpm (or sleep is poor): replace the AM hills with a 30-45 min Z1 spin or skip it. Ride the PM group ride sitting in and let surges go rather than chasing. Skip both only if you have illness symptoms (fever, chest symptoms).

days.details: 45 min gentle flow: hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine and glutes, with 5 min of breathing at the end. Drizzle forecast, so stay indoors. Keep it fully restorative after Tuesday's double.

60 min | Aerobic endurance + skills | Z2, RPE 3-4
Warm-up: 10 min Z1-2
Main: 45 min steady Z2 on flowing trails; practise smooth cornering and line choice, no hard efforts on climbs
Cool-down: 5 min Z1
Overcast and dry, wind to 25 km/h: good trail conditions.

150 min | Aerobic base rebuild | Z2, RPE 3-4
Warm-up: 15 min Z1-2
Main: 2 h steady Z2, low cadence drift on climbs allowed but stay in Z2; ride into the wind (up to 22 km/h) on the way out
Cool-down: 15 min easy Z1
Driest day of the week (4% rain).
Fuel: 40-60 g carbs per hour from the start, 1 bottle per hour.
If you wake with HRV under 44 ms and resting HR 56+, cut to 90 min Z1-2.

days.session: AM indoor threshold + PM Workout A
days.details:
AM (indoor trainer, drizzle and gusts to 35 km/h):
50 min | Threshold re-entry | Z4, 95-100% FTP, RPE 7
Warm-up: 12 min progressive Z1-Z2 incl. 2x30 s high cadence
Main: 3x8 min Z4, 4 min Z1-2 recovery between
Cool-down: 6 min Z1

PM (6+ h after the ride):
Workout A:
Warm-up: 5 min easy bike, hip/ankle mobility, 2 ramp-up sets on squat
Back Squat 3x6 (re-entry: start ~10% below last working load, 3 RIR)
Romanian Deadlift 3x6 (3 RIR)
Single-arm Dumbbell Row 3x8/side (2 RIR)
Pallof Press 3x10/side
Side Plank 3x30s/side
Rest: 2-3 min between squat and RDL sets, 60-90 s on accessories
Objective: Reintroduce heavy lower-body loading after ~6 weeks of minimal gym work without soreness that compromises next Tuesday's committed rides.
days.fallback: If HRV is below 44 ms with resting HR 56+ or poor sleep: ride 50 min steady Z2 indoors instead of the intervals, and do Workout A with 2 sets per lift at 4 RIR. If you feel unwell, rest completely.

days.details:
90 min | Aerobic volume, easy legs after Saturday | Z1-2, RPE 2-4
Warm-up: 10 min Z1
Main: 70 min relaxed Z2 on sheltered, tree-covered trails out of the wind (gusts to 29 km/h)
Cool-down: 10 min Z1
Light drizzle (0.6 mm) and cool (13-18°C): bring a light shell. Take a bottle with carbs.
